title: REDRUM Fear Park
specs: Four haunted attractions with new scenes, effects, and scares each season
Recommended for adults and teens; younger kids allowed if parents choose to bring them; carrying babies not recommended
Participants ages 14 and up eligible for $200 cash prize in best costume contest; ages 13 and under eligible for best costume gift basket prize
No additional group discounts; multiple discounted nights available throughout the season

blurb: Guests experience four haunted attractions at their own pace with unlimited re-entry during operating hours. The park includes live entertainment, interactive crowd actors, themed photo opportunities, midway games, food, and a festive Halloween atmosphere. New attractions and enhancements are introduced for each season.
extraNote: Tickets must be purchased online; no credit cards or cash accepted at ticket booth · Ticket sales stop one hour prior to close; haunted house lines close 10 minutes before park closes · No refunds if anyone decides not to finish · Transfer tickets via online account · Parking is free · Military and First Responders Appreciation Night tickets $30 at door with valid ID; includes one General Admission wristband
